question: Who among the following nationalist leaders was popularly known as 'Deshbandhu'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chittaranjan Das.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Chitranjan Das is also known as Deshbandhu.
 
• He was a Freedom fighter and originally belonged to West Bengal.
 
• He was one of the Founding members of the Swaraj Party.
 
• He was associated with Anushilan Samiti.
 
• Anushilan Samiti was active in Bengal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dadabhai Naoroji, the “Grand Old Man of India”, was the first Indian member of the British parliament.

 
 
• In 1865 and 1866, Naoroji helped found the London Indian Society and the East India Association respectively.
 
• He was Congress president thrice, in 1886, 1893, and 1906.
 
• Dadabhai Naoroji was among the key proponents of the ‘Drain Theory’, disseminating it in his 1901 book ‘Poverty and Un-British Rule in India’.
 
 
 
• **Ashutosh Mukherjee** was the Educator, Second Vice-Chancellor of Calcutta University, and the Judge of Calcutta High Court.
 
• **Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya **was born in Allahabad (now Prayagraj) in Uttar Pradesh.
 
 
• He played a key role in the Indian independence struggle against British rule.
 
• He was given the title of ‘Mahamana’ by Rabindranath Tagore and the second President of India, Dr S. Radhakrishnan gave him the status of a ‘Karmayogi’.
 
• He founded the Banaras Hindu University (BHU) in 1916.
 
• He helped establish the Hindu Mahasabha (“Great Society of Hindus”) in 1906.
